suites.name: e2e
tail: PASS list_commands shows built-ins and a project add-on with its params
PASS run_command runs the add-on across editor ticks
PASS an unknown command is an error that lists the known ones
PASS the window harness says plainly when it cannot run (not Windows)
PASS save saves the level and the changed packages
PASS output_log filters the editor log
PASS a frozen editor gives a clear timeout, not a hang

suites.name: contract
tail: PASS an unknown job id is code UNKNOWN_JOB
PASS batch runs its commands in order, waiting ones included
PASS batch stops at the first error
PASS under a READ policy the batch itself (MUTATE) is refused
PASS batch can't smuggle a DESTRUCTIVE command past a MUTATE policy, and runs nothing
PASS capture_view renders a PNG from the editor camera and removes its capture actor
PASS an unknown command is an error, code UNKNOWN, listing the known ones

suites.name: walk
tail: PASS test.count                   MUTATE         driven      ok
PASS test.countdown               MUTATE         driven      ok
PASS test.freeze                  MUTATE         excluded    stops the stand-in's ticks on purpose (the frozen-editor canary in tes
PASS test.policy                  READ           excluded    changes the bridge's policy; harness.contract drives it on purpose
PASS test.remote_calls            MUTATE         driven      ok
PASS test.remote_off              MUTATE         excluded    switches the stand-in's Remote Execution off for the rest of the run
PASS viewport_screenshot          SENSITIVE_READ driven      ok
